name: Writing Desk With Cable Grommet
description: Panel-sided writing desk: 1200 x 600 mm top at 740 mm, full-depth side panels, a modesty panel, and a 60 mm cable grommet through the top.

steps.instruction: Create the desktop: a 1200 x 600 mm slab, 25 mm thick, centered in X and Y, top face at Z=740 (slab from Z=715 to Z=740). The back edge is at Y=+300.

transcript.user_prompt: Start a writing desk. Create the desktop: a slab 1200 mm long (X), 600 mm deep (Y), 25 mm thick, centered in X and Y with its top face at Z=740 (slab from Z=715 to Z=740). Treat Y=+300 as the back edge.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 1200 x 600 mm desktop, 25 mm thick with its writing surface at 740 mm.

steps.instruction: Add two side panels 18 mm thick, 600 mm deep (full desk depth) and 715 mm tall (Z=0 to Z=715), centered at X=+/-591 so their outer faces are flush with the desktop ends.

transcript.user_prompt: Give it panel sides instead of legs: two panels 18 mm thick, the full 600 mm depth of the desk, running from the floor at Z=0 up to the desktop's underside at Z=715. Center them at X=+/-591 so their outer faces finish flush with the ends of the top.
transcript.assistant_message: Both side panels are up - 18 mm thick, full depth, flush with the desktop ends and carrying the top at 740 mm.

steps.instruction: Add a modesty panel 16 mm thick spanning the 1164 mm between the side panels, from Z=300 up to Z=715, flush with the back edge (Y=284 to Y=300).

transcript.user_prompt: Close the back partially with a modesty panel: 16 mm thick, spanning the full 1164 mm between the side panels, from Z=300 up to the desktop's underside at Z=715, with its outer face flush with the desk's back edge at Y=300.
transcript.assistant_message: The modesty panel now ties the two sides together across the back, from 300 mm off the floor up to the desktop - the front stays open for legroom.

steps.instruction: Cut a 60 mm diameter cable grommet vertically through the desktop at X=0, Y=200 (100 mm from the back edge). The top spans Z=715 to Z=740, so the hole must pass through that full thickness.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill a cable grommet through the desktop: a 60 mm diameter vertical hole centered at X=0, 100 mm in from the back edge (so at Y=200), passing all the way through the 25 mm top which spans Z=715 to Z=740.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the 60 mm cable grommet through the top at X=0, Y=200 - cables can now drop behind the modesty panel.
